summary_zh: 泰國工業部長下令自11月1日起清查5府電子廢棄物工廠，違規者將被關廠，並修法加重罰則。環保稽查趨嚴（P034）持續發酵，在泰製造商需盡快檢視廢棄物與排放管控；另天災停工（P070）議題亦在上升。
summary_en: Thailand's industry minister ordered inspections of e-waste factories in 5 provinces from Nov 1, with violators facing closure and tougher penalties via legal amendments. Stricter environmental enforcement (P034) persists; natural-disaster stoppages (P070) are rising.
